prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in the sunlit arches of the Roman Colosseum with worn stone paving, standard-height arched doorways and low stone steps, empty of tourists, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, THREE people standing close side by side, shoulder to shoulder in a single row, with just enough spacing that every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back far enough that all three are visible from head to toe, the whole row filling the width of the tall frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult American woman, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, sun-kissed skin, heavily sculpted contour and a strong highlighter on the cheekbones, bold defined brows, long fluffy false lashes, shimmery bronze eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, plump glossy nude lips with a defined lip-liner outline, a confident, camera-ready smile, deep jet-black with a glossy sheen hair styled in a low chignon knot at the nape, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large bronze hoop carrying three heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on bronze chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a copper cube-shaped block, a copper square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold ship's anchor, a gold teardrop-shaped sinker, a copper small flared temple bell, a silver square-sided cowbell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single silver ring. Extra long nails in matching polished wenge wood.
LEFT Physique: an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust projecting far forward and wider than her shoulders is the first thing the eye lands on, and directly below it her waist pulls in to an impossibly narrow, sharply defined line with a deep shadowed groove, then full round hips and soft thick thighs flare out beneath as a strong second curve; the drop from bust to waist is the most dramatic part of her silhouette; not thin, not boyish, not a straight figure; her head looks small above her bust; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
LEFT Body Art: full body near-black wenge wood carved directly over her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid carved wood curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted carved sections whose grain changes direction from one section to the next, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own soft glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING near-black wenge grain across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID gold-tan pinstripes running between the carved sections, polished to a warm satin sheen, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Her face and ears are real living skin, and her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved near-black wenge wood.

LEFT Cracks: the near-black wenge wood body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her right hip, and one chipped-off piece at her belly, where the broken edge reveals the pale raw fresh wood with a rough splintered grain, much lighter than the dark polished outside inside. Everywhere else, including her bust, the near-black wenge wood is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
LEFT Pose: one hand trailing along her thigh, the other behind her back, hip tilted.
LEFT Footwear: Extreme platform stiletto pumps in nude leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved near-black wenge wood right down to the shoes.

CENTER: ONE real adult Filipino man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a delicate beautiful-boy face with long lashes, a slim straight nose and a clean jawline, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, smooth warm tan skin, a calm gentle gaze, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in a high top-knot bun, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large gold hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on gold chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, an iron ship's anchor, a bronze barrel-shaped weight, a copper chunky hexagonal nut-shaped weight with a round hole through the centre), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and seven to ten heavily stacked rose-gold bracelets. Extremely long square nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
CENTER Physique: An extraordinarily large and muscular man, far beyond any real person, built like a muscle model. Wide broad shoulders, a full thick defined chest, large rounded arms with clear biceps and triceps, a hard defined abdomen on a trim waist, wide flaring lats, and strong muscular thighs and calves in balance with the upper body. Powerful and imposing, yet lean and polished. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
CENTER Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing nothing but a minimal T-back thong of thin polished gold chains, with one small opaque gold plate at the front on chain sides tied at the hips and a single thin gold chain down the back, the small opaque piece fully covering him, his skin otherwise fully bare.
CENTER Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
CENTER Footwear: Extreme olive-green high-top platform sneakers with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

RIGHT: ONE real adult Samoan man in his early 30s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, deep plum smoky eyes with dark lashes, smooth warm brown skin, a gentle soft smile, icy platinum-blonde hair styled in long thick box braids, real living eyes, wearing a different earring on each ear: on one ear a large copper hoop carrying four heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on copper chains of different lengths (a gold pyramid-shaped lump, a lead cube-shaped block, an iron ship's anchor, a lead barrel-shaped weight), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and on the other ear a single long gold chain ending in one large faceted ruby drop with a heavy rough gold a miniature anvil hanging at its end, and four to six layered rose-gold hair ornaments. Extremely long oval nails, chrome finish studded with crystals.
RIGHT Physique: A tall, extraordinarily well-built athletic man, far beyond any real person in size, built like a fitness model. Broad shoulders, a full athletic chest, a lean defined abdomen with a clear eight-pack, strong toned arms, a narrow waist, and long strong toned legs with defined calves. Large and powerful in frame, yet taut, lean and elegant rather than bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
RIGHT Outfit: His skin is bare and unpainted, wearing a minimal mirror-polished metallic black leather micro brief of one tiny low-rise opaque triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, the small opaque piece fully covering him, paired with a mirror-polished metallic black leather chest harness of thin crossing straps with mirror-polished metallic silver ring hardware, his chest and stomach otherwise fully visible.
RIGHT Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back.
RIGHT Footwear: Extreme silver chelsea boots with thick platform soles rising far higher than his ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary sole.

Skin (everyone): Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh and muscle fold. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Background & Lighting: each material catching the sunlight in sharp glints, the sunlight carving every fold, curve and muscle. Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide, all faces toward the camera.
